Oct 22, 2019 • Less than a minute read

Our first [NLP transfer learning paper for identifying phenotype mentions](https://doi.org/10.2196/14782) has been accepted by [JMIR Medical Informatics](https://medinform.jmir.org/) a relatively new journal (started in 2013) with an inaugural impact factor of 3.188.

Honghan Wu, Karen Hodgson, Sue Dyson, Katherine I. Morley, Zina M. Ibrahim, Ehtesham Iqbal, Robert Stewart, Richard JB Dobson, Cathie Sudlow. Efficient Reuse of Natural Language Processing Models for Phenotype-Mention Identification in Free-text Electronic Medical Records: A Phenotype Embedding Approach. JMIR Med Inform 2019;7(4):e14782. DOI:10.2196/14782 PMID: 31845899. 2019
